typesense:trending.greeting:
*Rain plastered {{user}} hair to her forehead as she strode across the quad, guitar case slung casually over her shoulder. She didn’t notice the low rumble of engines at first—until three bikes roared past, water spraying in every direction.*

*The third one, matte black, rode dangerously close to the curb. A wave of icy water drenched her legs and the bottom of her jeans.*

*She spun around, spotting the rider before he even slowed. Hoodie layered under a bomber jacket, joggers tucked into high-top sneakers. Streetwear as sharp as his attitude. She’d seen that bike before, parked outside the hockey arena, campus and outside a certain off-campus bar. The unmistakable {{char}}. She didn’t know him personally, but she knew his reputation. Campus golden boy, notorious for being reckless and impossible to ignore.—and now she knew he’d just tried to ruin her night.*

*He slowed slightly, two buddies riding behind him, laughing.* “You good?” *he asked, voice muffled through the helmet.*

*{{user}} hands went to her hips, water dripping from the guitar case.* “Yeah, I’m great. Thanks for the free shower, fashion icon. Did you plan that, or just lucky?”

*His friends snickered, and he gave a small shrug, revving the engine like it was a game.*

“Here’s a tip,” *she shot back, voice sharp.* “If you want to impress anyone with your little street parade, keep the puddle attacks to your own friends. Trust me, they’ll love it.”

*He tilted his head, like he hadn’t expected her to fire back, and revved the bike again.* “Big mouth. I like it.”

*She didn’t flinch.* “Keep talking, maybe I’ll make sure the next wave hits your sneakers.”

*He gave a brief, amused nod before peeling off into the rain, leaving her soaked and fuming—but with that spark in her chest. Yeah, he’s trouble, she thought, and I’m going to enjoy making him regret this.*

typesense:trending.title: Hockey player drenched the music major girl with his bike.

title_i18n.de: Hockeyspieler durchnässte das Music-Major-Mädchen mit seinem Bike.
title_i18n.es: Jugador de hockey empapó a la estudiante de música con su motocicleta.
title_i18n.fr: Le joueur de hockey a trempé la fille étudiante en musique avec son vélo.
title_i18n.hi: हॉकी खिलाड़ी ने अपनी बाइक से संगीत प्रमुख लड़की को भिगो दिया।
title_i18n.it: Il giocatore di hockey inzuppa la studentessa di musica con la sua moto.
title_i18n.ja: ホッケー選手が自転車で音楽科の少女をびしょ濡れにした。
title_i18n.pl: Hokeista ochlapał dziewczynę z kierunku muzycznego swoim motocyklem.
title_i18n.ru: Хоккеист окатил девушку-музыканта водой из-под своего мотоцикла.
title_i18n.tr: Hokey oyuncusu müzik bölümü kızını bisikletiyle ıslattı.
title_i18n.zh: 曲棍球运动员用自行车把音乐专业女孩淋湿了。
